usage: Used in cafes or restaurants to order a coffee. It is polite and standard across all regions of Morocco. You can specify the type of coffee by adding words like 'k7la' (black) or 'nss nss' (half milk, half coffee) immediately after 'qehwa'.

variants.label: black coffee
variants.note: Used when you want a standard espresso or black coffee without milk.

variants.label: half and half
variants.note: The most popular coffee order in Morocco, consisting of equal parts espresso and steamed milk.

variants.label: dash of milk
variants.english: A coffee with a dash of milk, please.
variants.note: Literally 'broken coffee', used to order a black coffee with just a small splash of milk.

variants.label: full sentence
variants.note: A slightly longer, standard way to order if you want to use a full verb phrase.

responses.english: Okay, it will be ready right away.

examples.english: Give me a black coffee, please.

examples.arabic: واشْ نْخَلَّصْ القَهْوَة دابا وْلا بَلّاتي؟
examples.transliteration: wash nkhelles lqehwa daba wla bellati?
examples.english: Should I pay for the coffee now or later?
